title: Hawk Stoop Canon of the Heavy Single Edge
summary: Teaches the finished hawk-style falchion, a field-fed stoop and return built on the paired track.

title: Twin-Court Falchion Counters
summary: Sets out the twin-court counters in which one blade turns the blow and the field answers it with a second cut.

title: River-Bend Cleaver Rolls
summary: Drills heavy cuts and turns that follow the bend of a river, slipping attacks and answering from the new line.

title: Rolls of the Basin Hold
summary: Teaches the basin hold, a field-wide guard that gathers blows into the falchion and sends them back as one cut.

title: Dual-Track Heavy Edge Codex
summary: Records the full dual-track forms of the heavy edge, with leg and blade fields run as one linked pair.

title: Paired Stoop and River Return
summary: Pairs a hawk's stoop with a river's return so that each falchion cut is followed by its mirror cut.

title: Hawk-Court Falchion Concordance
summary: Brings together the hawk-court teachings on the falchion into one ordered course for senior Xiantian students.

title: Wind-Sworn Treatise on the Heavy Edge
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn falchion in which the field rides the wind and the heavy edge falls on its bearing.

title: Plateau Oath Falchion Canon
summary: Sets out the plateau school's oath-held falchion cuts, steady as ground and heavy as an oath once sworn.

title: Gale-Bearing Cleaver Rolls
summary: Drills the turning cuts of the gale and the held bearing, all carried out with the field spread round the blade.

title: Oathline Falchion Counters
summary: Shows the oath-sworn counters that hold a fixed line and break an opponent's attack against it.

title: Plateau-Edge Falchion Cuts
summary: Teaches cuts made at the edge of the plateau, where the wind lends the heavy blade its sudden turns.

title: Windbound Falchion Manual
summary: Records the windbound forms in which the falchion's field is held close and released all at once in the cut.

title: The Long Bearing Treatise on the Cleaver
summary: Teaches the long held bearing from which a single great cleave of the falchion falls on the target.
